svg.title: Figure 5. Training seeds versus held-out seeds
svg.desc: Training and held-out estimates with 95% intervals for 28 rows; 3 rows have non-overlapping intervals.

g.text: Figure 5. Training seeds versus held-out seeds
held-out: 150 seeds, 614 population units; training: 20 seeds, 71 units (exploratory); 25 distinct rows of 28 (K1-K3 repeat other rows)
K1: Random control minus Static, lives lost
K2, K3: style contrast at wave 9
Open circle: training seeds (exploratory, used to design the plan). Filled circle: held-out seeds (K1-K3 confirmatory, other rows estimates).
Each row shows the training estimate and the held-out estimate with 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals; 3 of 28 rows are tagged
'no overlap' because their intervals do not overlap.
